fields.h1: Build a Lead Nurturing Workflow for Every Lead Not Ready to Buy
fields.hero_description: Build a lead nurturing workflow that puts each lead on the right track and hands it to a rep the moment the lead replies.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Into a Nurturing App
fields.features_subheading: Each part decides what a lead hears next, or which rep hears about the lead.
fields.feature_1:
A track for each way a lead arrives

The app enrolls each new lead by the guide or event that brought it in, and each track keeps its own emails and timing. Describe a new track in a prompt and Emergent builds it.
fields.feature_2:
Exit rules that end a track early

A reply, a booked meeting, an unsubscribe, or a closed deal ends the track, and no queued email goes out after it. You choose which of these events counts as an exit.
fields.feature_3:
Handoffs that carry the whole history

When a lead is ready for a person, the rep gets a Slack or email alert with the reply and every email the lead received. The call starts from what the lead has read.
fields.feature_4:
Lead records in a database you own

Every lead, track, and send is stored in a database you own. The app reads and writes contacts and deal stages in your CRM through its API, where your reps already work.
fields.feature_5:
Lost leads come back on a set date

A deal marked lost on timing, or a lead a rep marks as not now, gets a return date. On that date the app restarts nurturing for the contact and alerts the original rep.
fields.feature_6:
No task cap as the list grows

Sends and branch checks run with no task cap, whether the list holds 500 leads or 50,000. On paid plans, you can export the full code of the app to your own GitHub repository.

fields.usecase_heading: Where Each Lead Goes, and When It Leaves
fields.tab_content_1:
Tip pooling readers get restaurant emails for 21 days

Ottilie Marchbank, operations manager at Fennick Hall Bistros, downloads the tip pooling guide from Corvane Payroll. The app tags her by that guide and enrolls her in the restaurant track: 4 emails, on day 2, day 7, day 14, and day 21. A lead who downloads the overtime guide gets the hourly staff track instead.
fields.tab_content_2:
140 badge scans, 18 calls before the day ends

Hartsfell Robotics brings 140 badge scans home from a warehouse trade show, each with a booth note. The app sorts them by that note. The 18 hot leads reach the rep, Caspian Oduya, as call tasks the same day. The 97 warm leads start a 6-week track with one email a week, and the 25 cold leads get one recap email.
fields.tab_content_3:
One reply stops emails 4 and 5 for good

Henrike Valdes at Copperfold Dental Group replies to email 3 of 5 from Tallowmere Scheduling to ask whether it syncs with her phone system. The app cancels emails 4 and 5. Her reply goes to the rep Matthias Okonjo in a direct message, along with the 3 emails she received.
fields.tab_content_4:
Lost on timing, back in a track after 180 days

Brindlecrest HR lost the Wexcombe Logistics deal, and the rep logged the reason as timing: the budget was frozen. After 180 days, the app puts the contact, Perpetua Lindgren, into a 3-email check-in track and sends the original rep, Leocadia Fenn, a direct message with the lost reason.

fields.howto_title: How to Build a Lead Nurturing Workflow
fields.howto_description: These 7 steps map your lead sources into a lead nurturing workflow and test it on last month's leads before it goes live.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List every way a lead reaches you
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Write one track per entry point
fields.howto_step_1_des: Pull last quarter's new leads and group them by what brought them in: a guide, an event, a demo form, or a referral. Any group with 20 or more leads earns its own track.
fields.howto_step_2_des: For each group, write the emails in order with the day each one goes out. Keep a track to 5 emails or fewer, and let each email answer one question that group asks before buying.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide which rep receives a lead that leaves a track, and whether the alert goes to Slack or email. A lead that already has an owner in your CRM goes back to that owner.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Paste your tracks and handoff rules into a prompt. Emergent builds the app with its database and a dashboard that shows each lead's current track and next send.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Connect your CRM and email tool
fields.howto_step_5_des: Give the app API access to your CRM and to the tool that sends your email. Map each field the tracks read, such as lead source and deal stage, before any lead is enrolled.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Run last month's leads through it
fields.howto_step_6_des: Load last month's leads in test mode and check which track each one lands in. Compare the result with what your reps would have chosen, and fix any rule that disagrees.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Go live on one entry point
fields.howto_step_7_des: Turn on the track with the most leads first and keep the others manual for 2 weeks. Read every handoff message in that time, then switch on the next track.

faq_plan.q: What is a lead nurturing workflow?
faq_plan.a: A lead nurturing workflow is the set of rules that chooses the next message for a lead that is not ready to buy, and the moment a rep takes over. Lead nurturing itself is the act of educating a lead and moving them through the stages of your customer lifecycle. The workflow turns that into steps: the track a lead enters, and the event that hands it to a person.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a lead nurturing workflow?
faq_plan.a: Group your leads by what brought them in, write one short track for each group, and decide which events end a track. Describe those tracks in Emergent's AI automation builder, and Emergent builds the app and its database from your prompt. Connect your CRM through its API, then run last month's leads through the tracks before you switch them on.

faq_plan.q: What are good lead nurturing workflow examples to start with?
faq_plan.a: Start with tracks tied to something the lead did. A lead who views your pricing page twice in a week can move to a shorter track with a case study and a meeting link. A free trial that ends without an upgrade can start a track built on the setup questions trial users send your support team. Emergent adds either one to the app when you ask for it in a prompt.

faq_plan.q: How do I keep the emails in a lead nurturing workflow from going stale?
faq_plan.hint: How to automate lead nurturing workflows?
faq_plan.a: Review each track every quarter and replace any email whose guide or offer has been retired. Store each email's link alongside the track to see at a glance which emails still point to old pages. When your content workflow publishes a new guide, add it to the track for the group that asks that question, and drop the email it replaces.

faq_plan.q: What lead data does a lead nurturing workflow need?
faq_plan.hint: Are there any tools that help automate lead nurturing workflows?
faq_plan.a: Each lead needs two fields beyond a valid email address: the source that brought it in and an owner, even if the owner field is empty. The source picks the track, and the owner decides who gets the handoff. Add company size or role only when a track reads it. The app keeps these fields in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: How many emails should a lead nurturing workflow send?
faq_plan.hint: How to automate lead nurturing workflows best practices?
faq_plan.a: Start with 5 emails or fewer, and widen the gap between them as the track goes on. Add an email only when leads are still opening the last one you send. Each email should answer one question the group asks before buying, and the last one should ask plainly whether the lead wants to talk to someone.

faq_plan.q: What happens to a lead after it leaves a lead nurturing workflow?
faq_plan.hint: How to automate lead nurturing workflows for e commerce?
faq_plan.a: It goes to a person or back into a waiting period, depending on why it left. A reply or a booked meeting sends it to the owning rep, and from there your sales workflow sets the stages the deal moves through. An unsubscribe ends all email to that address. A lead that finishes a track without responding can wait 90 days and then start a check-in track.

faq_plan.q: How do I measure whether a lead nurturing workflow is working?
faq_plan.a: Track two numbers for each track every month: the share of enrolled leads that reach a rep, and the days it takes them to get there. If fewer than 1 in 20 leads in a track reach a rep within 90 days, rewrite its emails or change its exit rule. Emergent can build a dashboard with both numbers per track, from the same database the tracks run on.

faq_plan.q: How do I keep a lead on only one lead nurturing workflow track at a time?
faq_plan.a: Give each lead one active track at a time, and rank your tracks in priority order. When a lead qualifies for a second track, the app keeps it on the higher-ranked track and queues the other until the first one ends. A trade show lead who also downloads a guide, for example, stays on the event track until it finishes.

faq_plan.q: How is a lead nurturing workflow different from lead scoring?
faq_plan.a: Scoring ranks leads by what they do, while nurturing picks the emails each lead gets until it is ready to talk to a rep. The two meet at the handoff, where a score threshold can be the event that ends a track. Points for page views and an alert at a set score belong in a marketing automation workflow, and the nurture track reads the score it produces.

plan.angle: The SERP for lead nurturing workflow is glossary posts and email-template listicles that stop at sending a sequence. This page shows the decisions a nurturing app makes about leads that are not ready to buy: which track a lead enters based on the content that brought it in, how a pile of trade-show scans is split by the booth note, when a reply ends the track and goes to a rep, and when a deal lost on timing comes back. Timed email series belong to drip campaign, scoring and cart recovery to marketing automation workflow, rep assignment and stalled deals to CRM automation, and demo follow-up to sales automation.
